plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand logo anchors the left edge, the bottle sits as a square product beat, a wide text column lets the headline run on one line with the subline beneath, and the NEW VIDEO badge closes on the right as the action tag.

Product-first strip: the bottle opens at the far left, a dominant centre text block carries headline over subline, and a right-hand brand stack groups the NEW VIDEO badge above the logo so the tag and brand sign off together.
Faithful to the original's composition: headline-led text block on the left, then the NEW VIDEO badge sitting beside the bottle as in the source, with the logo signing off on the far right edge.
